title: Who Gets a Token, and What Does It Carry? Unequal Name Support and Concept Access in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating tokenizer allocation rates (atomic vs. fragmented representations) and measuring internal concept accessibility via task-specific adjective probabilities at intermediate model layers using matched first names associated with different racial and ethnic groups (Asian/PI, Hispanic, NH Black, NH White).

Evaluating tokenizer allocation rates (atomic vs. fragmented representations) and measuring internal concept accessibility via task-specific adjective probabilities at intermediate model layers using matched first names associated with male versus female genders.
